info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Seafood Laptop Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Seafood Laptop Details Management API enables businesses to create and manage detailed information related to seafood laptops within a catalog. This API facilitates the addition of specific product details, such as specifications, pricing, and availability, to enhance the catalog offerings. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems aimed at optimizing seafood laptop listings for customers. By leveraging this API, organizations can ensure that their product data is accurate and up-to-date, driving better engagement and sales.

post.description: This operation allows users to submit and manage details related to seafood laptops. It facilitates the capturing of critical information necessary for processing and retrieval in the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for a seafood laptop operation. Ensure that the JSON structure follows the defined schema to successfully process the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returns the requested details.

seafood_laptop_id.description: The unique identifier for the seafood laptop.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person who requested this operation.

quantity.description: The quantity of seafood laptops requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the seafood laptop.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the seafood laptop.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the seafood laptop.

supplier.description: Details about the supplier of the seafood laptop.

warehouseCodes.description: A list of warehouse codes where the seafood laptops are stored.

CreateCatalogSeafoodLaptopDetailRequest.description: Request body schema for creating or updating details related to a seafood laptop operation.

width.description: The width of the seafood laptop.

height.description: The height of the seafood laptop.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the dimensions.

Dimensions.description: Schema representing the dimensions of the seafood laptop.

verified.description: Indicates whether the supplier is verified.

Supplier.description: Schema representing the supplier of the seafood laptop.

CreateCatalogSeafoodLaptopDetailResponse.title: Seafood Laptop Operation Response

CreateCatalogSeafoodLaptopDetailResponse.description: Response schema for the Seafood Laptop Operations POST request, containing the status, record ID of the processed record, timestamps, matched count, pricing details, and any warnings generated during processing.
